title: A merge through the merge hook (a train, or any merge not…
what: plugins/relay/hooks/merge.py:226: MEDIUM: F4 a merge through the merge hook (a train, or any merge not made by relay land) still lands a branch whose fix item is taken and open
why: 29 Oct, review of wt/a-landed-branch-can-leave-its-queue-item, F4 (outside): relay land now refuses a branch whose taken fix item is still open, but a merge through the merge hook (a train, or any merge not made by relay land) still lands it, leaving the item taken by a deleted branch; three items were left that way on 29 Oct.
failing_case: Train wt/train-9 merges rider wt/a, whose fix item `a-item` is taken by wt/a and was never closed with relay queue done; the
front merges the train into master (relay land has no trains, owner 28 Oct). step_queue judges only items the range closes
(state done), so the merge passes and a-item stays taken by wt/a, which is then deleted.
Should: the merge is refused naming relay queue done a-item -C <wt/a worktree> --test ...
pass_cases: 1. Train holding a rider with its fix item taken and open: the merge hook refuses, naming the item and the done command.
2. Train whose riders closed their items with a check of Q1 MET: merges as today.
3. Branch with no item: merges as today.
